The '''Grey Shroud terrorists''' were a group of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Grey Shroud terrorists were [[Grey Shroud Terrorist Base|based]] in the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]], near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agents led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] assaulted the base and killed the Grey Shroud leader [[Ebela Puckett]]. The assault was part of a larger operation which aim was to infiltrate an agent among the criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]]. The true objective of the assault against the Grey Shroud was to demonstrate the loyalty of the agent to the Chirq Council. The CorSec agent pretended that Ebela Puckett was an informant tasked by the CorSec to spy the Council. With the support of manufactured evidences, the agent managed to convince the Chirq Council underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] that this story was real and successfully infiltrated the organization.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grey Shroud terrorists appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Grey Shroud terrorists were added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
